mostWorthwhile.text: Adding vessels to the deeper tissue was most worthwhile: it showed how living outer cells get supplies even though their layer has no blood vessels.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the sweat gland was straightforward but didn't add much explanation on its own.

surprise.text: I didn't expect the outer skin layer to have no blood vessels; the deeper tissue supplies its living cells.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The pictures and named slots made the fittings clear, though the final nerve fitting was the only offered combination.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter: connecting the skin's barrier, blood supply and sensory parts was clear, though the fittings themselves were fairly predictable.
